products.name: 华泰柏瑞沪深300ETF
products.paper_role: half of the equity sleeve when the equity sleeve is selected
products.exposure: CSI 300 constituents and substitutes; normally at least 95 percent of NAV; full replication
products.rule_fail_closed: No automatic substitute if documentation, status, quote, IOPV or account checks fail.

products.name: 华泰柏瑞上证红利ETF
products.paper_role: half of the equity sleeve when the equity sleeve is selected
products.exposure: SSE Dividend Index constituents and substitutes; normally at least 95 percent of NAV; full replication
products.rule_fail_closed: The dividend label does not establish a distribution, cash-flow or return target; the sleeve fails closed if either equity leg cannot be checked.

products.name: 国泰上证5年期国债ETF
products.paper_role: bond sleeve when the bond sleeve is selected
products.exposure: SSE 5-Year Treasury Bond Index; normally at least 90 percent of NAV in index and substitute treasuries; optimized sampling
products.rule_fail_closed: Category-level T+0 information is not product or broker confirmation; no paper action without current settlement and quote checks.

products.name: 华安黄金ETF
products.paper_role: gold sleeve when the gold sleeve is selected
products.exposure: domestic gold spot contracts and related gold instruments; gold spot normally at least 90 percent of fund assets
products.rule_fail_closed: No paper action if IOPV, quote or settlement facts are missing; gold is not an automatic hedge assertion.

products.name: 华宝现金添益ETF（A类）
products.paper_role: full fallback only when no risk sleeve is positive
products.exposure: deposits, repos, central-bank bills, certificates of deposit, limited-term debt financing instruments, bonds, ABS and other liquid money-market instruments
products.disclosed_expenses: management 0.35%/year; custody 0.09%/year; sales service 0.25%/year; composite operating cost 0.69%/year
products.rule_fail_closed: It is not a bank deposit, cash-receipt objective or frictionless conversion mechanism; actual account and settlement facts remain required.
